COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 24, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:30 PM
Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner

  Commission for Women and Girls In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to submit online and email public comments
  to Kimberly.Marshall@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 939 3435 2621
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93934352621

 Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access and
  public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55509  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, May 27, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55510  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Long Beach Fire
  Department on department-wide efforts to advance equitable workplace
  accommodations across Fire Department facilities, including updates on the
  implementation of gender-inclusive facilities at the Long Beach Fire Regional
  Training Center funded through the Fiscal Year 2026 Adopted Budget.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55511  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Ranked Choice Voting
  Ad Hoc Committee regarding Ranked Choice Voting and its potential impacts on

  the representation and civic participation of women and girls in local elections and,
  if appropriate, approve a letter to the Mayor and City Council for transmittal.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55512  Recommendation to discuss and designate Commissioners to attend the National
  Association of Commissions for Women (NACW), and discuss establishing a
  process for the Commission to designate Commissioners to attend external
  meetings, conferences, and networking organizations.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55513  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR, VICE CHAIR, AND TREASURER ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to
the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
